analysis.method: Camera sampling first; common aliased reciprocal-lattice notches; DC retained
order: incoherent sources -> AG thin phase screen -> focused circular-pupil wave imaging
square detector area integration -> discrete sensor samples
DFT -> common periodic-bin mask -> inverse DFT -> 100*std/mean
analysis.roi_rule: 840 um = 32 detector pixels = integer multiples of every exact G period; 420 um nested ROI is a sensitivity check
analysis.mask_rule: Enumerate reciprocal vectors within the optical intensity bandwidth, fold modulo sensor sampling frequency, remove the union of exact DFT bins for all layouts; retain DC
analysis.detector: Monochrome, linear, 100% square active area; noiseless, unquantized; no Bayer/ISP
analysis.focus: OLED emission plane through the flat reference stack; ideal aberration-free pupil already present in the optical solver
analysis.metric_scope: Camera-domain stochastic contrast under the declared mask, not a visually weighted or SMS-1000 calibrated reading

references.title: IEC 62977-3-9:2023, informative Annex B and Table B.1
references.use: Frequency-domain removal of periodic display modulation; compare only identical filter designs. The exact common mask here is explicitly specified by this protocol, not mandated by IEC.

references.title: Becker (2021), 10 years of sparkle measurement, sections 3.1-3.4
references.use: Camera MTF, detector sampling, aliased periodic peaks, then Fourier masking of electronic images. The optional visual-frequency cutoff is not used for this camera-domain metric.

limitations: Representative aperture polygons, not calibrated commercial panels
P is nominal logical-address pitch, not equal nearest-neighbor emitter spacing
One AG realization and one declared relative emitter phase; not a phone-quality ranking

roughness.definition: Areal Sa/Sq relative to the mean plane; Sz is sampled peak-to-valley, not PNG encoding range.
